content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification:** deviation (walk-away language in § 13.1), cured at the **preferred** level with one surgical edit.

- **§ 13.1** (subscription Services grant) was the problem: "Customer alone", "non-transferable", "revocable at Vendor's sole discretion", and express exclusion of Affiliates and contractors with no path to add them.
- **§ 13.2** already delivers the paid-up perpetual/irrevocable licence to Customer *and its Affiliates*, with contractor support — those two preferred elements are already met.
- **§ 13.3 + § 24.1** already give a transfer right to an Affiliate or successor (merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets, no consent) — successor-transfer element already met — and cap revocation at uncured material breach after notice and cure.
- The single replace in § 13.1 adds Affiliates and contractors, deletes at-will revocation (tying revocation to § 13.3's uncured material breach standard), and removes "non-transferable" so it no longer contradicts § 13.3. No personnel/access clause prohibits contractor use, so no collateral rewrites were needed.
